subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked as €, ₭, ₮, ₴, ₹, ₾. Select the symbol that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '€'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0153ded0c30e9ea3d6a61a7cd825d13efc9ac485fd9e6265e25a72d4a0e4a009.png]
solution:
**Given :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0153ded0c30e9ea3d6a61a7cd825d13efc9ac485fd9e6265e25a72d4a0e4a009.png] 

In the image we can see that the left of ₹ is ₭ and the right of ₹ is €.

In a dice the left and right of the same face are placed opposite to each other. And in this case ₭ and € are in this position. Therefore 

₭ is the face opposite to €

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b508db469c1adebdd0ce2700e43783302443544ba0db84d5dc93c6cb8fed776.png] 

'€' is opposite to ₭

Hence, ₭ is the correct answer.
